track.description: Topic-by-topic DSA: concepts first, then the interview problems that use them.
track.name: Data Structures & Algorithms

chapters.name: Arrays
chapters.description: Traversal, in-place tricks, Kadane, and the patterns every other topic builds on.

chapters.name: Strings
chapters.description: String manipulation, KMP, Z-algorithm, Rabin-Karp and palindromes.

chapters.name: Hashing
chapters.description: Hash maps and sets for counting, lookup and dedup.

chapters.name: Prefix Sum & Difference Array
chapters.description: Prefix sums, difference arrays and line sweep for range updates and queries.

chapters.name: Two Pointers
chapters.description: Opposite-end and fast/slow pointer patterns.

chapters.name: Sliding Window
chapters.description: Fixed and variable windows over arrays and strings.

chapters.name: Binary Search
chapters.description: Search on sorted data and binary search on the answer.

chapters.name: Sorting
chapters.description: Comparison sorts, custom comparators, counting sort.

chapters.name: Linked List
chapters.description: Pointer manipulation, reversal, cycles and merging.

chapters.name: Stack
chapters.description: Monotonic stacks, expression parsing and next-greater problems.

chapters.name: Queue
chapters.description: Queues, deques and monotonic deques.

chapters.name: Recursion
chapters.description: Thinking recursively: the foundation for trees, backtracking and DP.

chapters.name: Backtracking
chapters.description: Subsets, permutations, combinations and constraint search.

chapters.name: Trees
chapters.description: Binary tree traversals, views, LCA and path problems.

chapters.name: Binary Search Trees
chapters.description: BST properties, validation, insertion and deletion.

chapters.name: Heap / Priority Queue
chapters.description: Top-K, scheduling and k-way merge patterns.

chapters.name: Graphs
chapters.description: BFS, DFS, topological sort, shortest paths and MST.

chapters.name: Dynamic Programming
chapters.description: From recursion + memo to bottom-up, across all DP patterns.

chapters.name: Tries
chapters.description: Prefix trees for word search and XOR problems.

chapters.name: Greedy
chapters.description: Exchange arguments, intervals and greedy choice.

chapters.name: Bit Manipulation
chapters.description: Bitwise tricks, masks and XOR properties.

chapters.name: Math
chapters.description: Number theory, primes, GCD and combinatorics.

chapters.name: Segment Tree & BIT
chapters.description: Range queries with updates: segment trees and Fenwick trees.

chapters.name: Design Data Structures
chapters.description: LRU/LFU caches, randomized sets and other design-a-structure interview classics.

chapters.name: Advanced Techniques
chapters.description: Meet in the middle and other techniques for when brute force is just too slow.
